description.value: The study validated a modified Empathic Accuracy Task using naturalistic autobiographical emotional video clips, continuous ratings of emotional intensity, and a neutral control condition to examine neural correlates of empathic accuracy and dynamic emotional processing.

spans.text: The aim of this study was to validate a modified version of the Empathic Accuracy Task, using a staged analysis approach which replicates analyses presented previously in the literature, but which also included additional comparisons.
